messages:
alice.ae: Quick recap from GuardBridge call — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, domain-locked tenant and audit logging for the POC. They also asked about pricing and lowering onboarding.

tom.eng: We can support SAML SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Ask for IdP metadata (xml) + signing/encryption certs.

lina.sec: Send security questionnaire to security@redwood.com. Key items: data residency, KMS usage, pen-test reports, admin MFA, and log retention. Please request a redacted SAML response for validation.

alice.ae: They use Okta; said ~320 users to provision initially. They want group->role mapping by Okta groups.

tom.eng: For SCIM: SCIM v2 with PATCH supported. Minimal attributes: userName, externalId, active, name, emails, groups. If they want roles in SCIM include extension urn:enterprise:roles. Small test curl we usually send: `curl -X POST https://poc.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"userName":"u@guardbridge.com","active":true}'`

jordy.sre: POC env created: https://console.redwood.example/poc/guardbridge-1779132468 — creds shared via secure link. Audit logs enabled with default 90d retention. We can extend for a fee.

alice.ae: Commercial: proposing 12-day Dedicated POC (2x A10G equiv), 6 hours SE on-call, waived onboarding if they commit to pilot > $35k within 30 days. Estimate $7,200. Can discount onboarding — thoughts?

lina.sec: For Private deployment they asked about HSM/KMS. We support KMS; HSM is an add-on. Also require network allowlist and optional SIEM webhook for logs.

tom.eng: Note: group GUID mapping requires group sync enabled on Okta side. If they prefer SAML attribute mapping instead, ask IdP to include `roles` attribute. Also confirm logout (SLO) requirements — some IdPs enforce signed SLOs.

alice.ae: Action items: 1) I'll ask for IdP metadata + redacted SAML response, 2) Lina will send questionnaire and SOC2/pen-test docs, 3) Tom to upload SP metadata and SCIM endpoint + rate limits, 4) I'll send pricing draft to customer.

jordy.sre: SCIM rate limit note: default bulk import 400 users/min on Dedicated; we can temporarily raise to 1k/min for the POC.

alice.ae: Thanks team — I'll loop the customer in once we have SP metadata template and the questionnaire attached. :thumbsup:
